 Advertisement Milwaukee Brewers look to sweep World Series with ties to South Florida
 Advertisement Updated: 8:09 PM EDT Oct 27, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Shayne Wright Sports Director/Anchor Milwaukee Brewers look to sweep World Series with ties to South Florida
 Updated: 8:09 PM EDT Oct 27, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Shayne Wright Sports Director/Anchor The Milwaukee Brewers are one win away from a World Series title as they face the Tampa Bay Rays in Game 4 Tuesday night, holding a 3-0 lead in the series. 
 Hearst Owned WPBF 25 News The Milwaukee Brewers, leading the World Series 3-0, could clinch the championship on Tuesday night, with connections to Palm Beach County, Florida through their manager Pat Murphy (Florida Atlantic University baseball player) and pitcher Shane Drohan (Cardinal Newman High School graduate). Brewers manager Pat Murphy has ties to Florida, having attended Florida Atlantic University. 
 Advertisement Murphy played for FAU's inaugural baseball team in 1981 as a catcher and infielder and occasionally pitched. 
 Getty Images Erick W. Rasco Baseball: World Series: Milwaukee Brewers manager Pat Murphy during the game vs Tampa Bay Rays at Tropicana Field. Game 3. St. Petersburg, FL 10/26/2026CREDIT: Erick W. Rasco (Photo by Erick W. Rasco/Sports Illustrated via Getty Images) (Set Number: X164971 TK1) The latest: Sports coverage from WPBF 25 News 
 Brewers crush Rays in World Series Game 3 He was honored on FAU's 20th Anniversary Team and inducted into the school's Baseball Hall of Fame in 2008. 
 Getty Images Katelyn Mulcahy LOS ANGELES, CA - OCTOBER 15: Shane Drohan #55 of the Milwaukee Brewers looks on in the first inning during Game Four of the National League Championship Series between the Milwaukee Brewers and the Los Angeles Dodgers at UNIQLO Field at Dodger Stadium on Thursday, October 15, 2026 in Los Angeles, California. (Photo by Katelyn Mulcahy/MLB Photos via Getty Images) Brewers pitcher Shane Drohan is a Fort Lauderdale native and a 2017 graduate of Cardinal Newman High School in West Palm Beach. 
 'What an experience!': Former Brewers bat boy recalls 1982 World Series run Drohan played college baseball at Florida State and pitched one inning in the National League Championship Series, recording one strikeout.
